name: Pascal Canfin - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to set up a temporary fund that pays European factories making steel, aluminium, fertilisers, cement and some cereals when they export outside the EU. The money comes from a quarter of the revenues from the EU's carbon border levy. The aim is to stop these industries moving abroad because of carbon costs, while pushing them to cut emissions. The fund would run from 2027 to 2029, with payments starting sooner than the Commission proposed.

- **What changes:** Payments start in 2027, cover exported goods, and add smaller companies and cement, cereals and more fertiliser products.
- **Who it affects:** Steel, aluminium, fertiliser, cement and cereal producers that export, plus the smaller firms that buy from them.
- **What happens next:** Parliament votes on this position, then negotiates the final text with EU governments.
